title: Beyond MCQ: An Open-Ended Arabic Cultural QA Benchmark with Dialect Variants

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking open and closed LLMs on parallel QA datasets translated into Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), English, and four regional Arabic dialects (Egyptian, Levantine, Gulf, Maghrebi) to measure performance degradation on underrepresented linguistic varieties.

Evaluating models on questions specifically targeting Arab cultural knowledge (customs, history, geography, arts, everyday life) to assess gaps in culturally grounded reasoning compared to Western-centric defaults.

Converting Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) into Open-Ended Questions (OEQs) to measure the extent to which models rely on format artifacts, option guessing, or label bias rather than genuine internal knowledge and reasoning.
